church.name: Lampstand Church
church.address: 1180 Foundry Row in the Short North
church.times: every Sunday at 10 AM and 6 PM
church.parking: Park free in the lot behind the building or on the street. Look for the amber flags, and a greeter will meet you at the door.
church.pastors: Andre and Talia lead Lampstand together. They started it in 2019 in the back room of a Short North coffee shop, with a handful of college friends and one guitar. Talia is teaching our Lamps On series right now, and you will usually find them both by the stage after the 6 PM gathering.
church.kids: Lampstand Kids runs during the 10 AM gathering, from nursery through fifth grade. Check in at the kids desk just inside the main doors. Every leader is background checked, and the room is safe, happy and a little loud, like the rest of us.
church.students: Middle and high school students meet Sundays at 6. They sit together at the night gathering, then hang out after with leaders who know their names. College students and twentysomethings have their own crew too.
church.groups: Small groups meet in living rooms all over Columbus, every night of the week. Find one near you and come as you are. It is how a big, loud room starts to feel like family.
church.startHere: So glad you found us. Come on a Sunday, at 10 AM or 6 PM, and follow the amber flags. We will meet you at the door and point you to the coffee. After a visit or two, come to Start Here: one hour of lunch with Andre and Talia, and you will know where you fit.
church.give: You can give online in about a minute, once or every month. Every gift keeps the lights on, stocks our Thursday pantry and helps us buy the Foundry, our first permanent home.
church.watch: Every message is on YouTube after Sunday, and the 6 PM gathering streams live each week. The latest is Shine where you are, part 3 of Lamps On, with Pastor Talia.
church.prayer: On a real church site, the people you choose would pray for you that same day: tell us what is heavy, and we would be honored to pray with you. In this demo, nothing is sent. In danger or crisis? Call 911, or call or text 988.
church.values: Nobody lights a lamp to hide it. We worship loud, teach honestly and keep room for every voice, then carry that light into every corner of Columbus.

newhere.t: So glad you found us. Come on a Sunday, at 10 AM or 6 PM, and follow the amber flags. Plan your visit and we will meet you at the door and point you to the coffee. After a visit or two, come to Start Here: one hour of lunch with Andre and Talia, and you will know where you fit.

baptism.t: Our next Baptism Sunday is December 6, at 10 AM and 6 PM. It is one of our loudest days, with friends cheering you up out of the water. If you are ready to go public with your faith, ask about baptism and a pastor will talk it through with you first.

curious.t: Yes, come. Plenty of people in the room are still working out what they believe, and there is room for every voice here. Nobody will single you out. Follow the amber flags, find the coffee and bring your questions.

access.t: Yes. The main doors have a ramp, and the room, Lampstand Kids and the restrooms are all on the ground floor. Accessible parking is closest to the doors in the lot behind the building. Tell us on Plan Your Visit what would help, and a greeter will meet you at the door.

language.t: Our gatherings are in English. If another language would help you or your family, call us at (614) 555-0142 and we will help however we can.

communion.t: We share communion on the first Sunday of each month, at 10 AM and 6 PM. If you follow Jesus, you are welcome at the table. If you are still deciding, it is fine to sit it out.

wear.t: Come as you are. Jeans, hoodies, Sunday best. All of it fits here.

price.t: Genesis Ministry has three plans: Care at $149 a month, Shepherd at $299 a month and Plus at $499 a month. Enterprise, for more than one campus, is scoped on a call. Customization beyond the template is available for an additional cost.

package.t: Genesis Ministry has three plans: Care at $149 a month, Shepherd at $299 a month and Plus at $499 a month. Care is the website in one of four looks (this one is Bold and Dark), the brand board, the social marketing plan, Hope on the website (an assistant like me, answering from facts the church approves), Plan a Visit and prayer forms by email, and newsletter sign-up, with 2 staff logins. Shepherd is everything in Care, plus Today, the guest pipeline, the member app, the care inbox and drafts that wait for approval, with 5 staff logins. Plus is everything in Shepherd, plus person pages, the Access Record screen, the spiritual gifts picture, reports, custom roles and named gift viewers, with 15 staff logins. Enterprise, for more than one campus, is scoped on a call.
